title: North Korea Denies Record Binance Hack Involvement
excerpt: North Korea has denied responsibility for a record-breaking $6.3bn Binance hack attributed to them by the US and analysts.
body_html:
North Korea has publicly rejected accusations linking the country to a massive cryptocurrency theft. The statement follows claims from United States government agencies and various cyber security analysts pointing to Pyongyang as the perpetrator behind the record-breaking $6.3bn Binance heist.

Despite the allegations made by investigators and officials, the North Korean government maintains it had no involvement in the massive digital asset breach.
